asset: β-globin restored autologous hematopoietic stem cells

identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety and Efficacy Evaluation of β-globin Restored Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cells in β-thalassemia Major Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: Safety and Efficacy Evaluation of β-globin Restored Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cells in β-thalassemia Major Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open label study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of β-globin Restored Autologous Hematopoietic Stem Cells in ß-Thalassemia Major Patients
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: We will recruit ß-thalassaemia major patients and collect their autologous hematopoietic stem cells, which will be modified with the LentiHBBT87Q system to restore β-globin expression. After conditioning, the autologous hematopoietic stem cells with restored β-globin will be reinfused to the patients and followed up for two years to collect data.

armGroups.label: Experimental
armGroups.description: Ten transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia subjects aged 8-16 years will be reinfused with β-globin-restored autologous hematopoietic stem cells modified with LentiHBBT87Q.
interventionNames: Biological: β-globin restored autologous hematopoietic stem cells

interventions.name: β-globin restored autologous hematopoietic stem cells
interventions.description: β-globin-restored autologous hematopoietic stem cells modified with LentiHBBT87Q

primaryOutcomes.measure: Frequency and severity of adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs)
primaryOutcomes.description: The number and the percentage of adverse events related to transplantation in 100 days will be summarized according to NCI CTCAE 5.0
Number of patients alive through the whole trial will be record
Neutrophil count \[ANC\] \>=500 /mm3 for 3 consecutive days and platelet count \[PLT\] \>20,000/mm3 for7 consecutive days
The percentage of RCL should be negative in the 24 months after transplant
Evaluation of the percentage of participants without abnormal clonal proliferation and polyclonal engraftment . More than 1000 VIS retrieved from peripheral blood should be checked.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The average Insertion copy number (VCN) in peripheral blood mononuclear cells
secondaryOutcomes.description: The average insertion copy number (VCN) should be ≥0.1 in peripheral blood mononuclear cells

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The expression level of exogenous adult hemoglobin
secondaryOutcomes.description: Exogenous adult hemoglobin will be evaluated by globin chains and hemoglobin synthesis on peripheral blood by HPLC and the exogenous adult hemoglobin level is ≥2.0g/dL

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in annualized frequency of packed RBC transfusions
secondaryOutcomes.description: Compare the annualized number of pRBC transfusions before gene therapy with the Month 18 and Month 24 period after transplant, the percentage change will be recorded
